title: Traversal Using Relays around NAT (TURN): Relay Extensions to Session Traversal Utilities for NAT (STUN)
summary: Defines TURN, an extension of STUN that lets a host behind a NAT use a relay server to communicate with peers when direct connection is impossible. It is on the standards track and was replaced by RFC 8656.

eli5.summary: If two kids cannot throw a ball straight to each other because of a wall, they can use a friend in the middle to pass it. TURN is that friend. It was replaced by RFC 8656.

questions: how does a turn relay work with nat
